_comment: Copy to atlan.config.json and edit. Env vars override these. Nothing here is required — every value has a neutral default (projectsDir falls back to your home directory).
_previewTlsPort: Set ONLY if you reach the cockpit over https (e.g. `tailscale serve`). An http iframe inside an https page is silently blocked as mixed content, so the preview needs a TLS front door in front of previewPort: run `tailscale serve --bg --https=4591 4590`, then set this to 4591. Left at 0 the preview tells you this instead of guessing a port.
